note: The same variant node as product-card-image/root. The conversion split it across two elements: the root carries the box's size and the surface carries its paint — radius, the gray-200 stroke, and the gradient. Both are listed so the node's stroke is claimed by something; auditing the root alone reported the stroke as unclaimed.
